about: The values make secrets-audit takes for a placeholder and not for a secret, wherever a gitleaks rule matches them: in docs, examples and test scripts. Each entry is one regular expression of JavaScript, tested without regard to case against the whole value gitleaks matched, without its quotes, and for a user:password pair against the password as well. Every example must match its entry, or the run stops. lib/secrets-audit.mjs carries no placeholder of its own. The format is described on the wiki page Checkout audit, section Placeholders.

placeholders.note: the user name repeated as the password
a word that stands for a password
a value that asks for one's own
a placeholder in braces, as templates write it
an expression of the shell or of GitHub Actions that the value is taken from, alone or as the user and the password of a pair
words that name what stands in their place, one of them password, token or secret
a value cut short, as a document shows the start of a token
